title: Development of an enzyme immunoassay to measure urinary and faecal 5α-androst-16-en-3-one in pigs
author: Kumar, Umapathy
materials: The indirect competitive ELISA procedure for 5α-androst-16-en-3-one was carried out as previously reported [27], [28], [29]. The 96 well microtiter plate (Nunc Maxisorp; Immuno plate, Denmark) was coated with 100 µL of 1 µg conjugate/mL of 16, (5α)-androsten-3-one-carboxymethyloxime: BSA (diluted in coating buffer, 0.05 M sodium bicarbonate buffer, pH 9.6), placed in moist chamber and covered with cling wrap and incubated overnight at 4 °C. The plate's contents were removed, and an automated ELISA washer (Elx50, BioTek, USA) was used to wash the plate four times with wash buffer (0.15 M NaCl, 0.05% Tween 20). After blocking the plate with 200 µl of blocking buffer, it was incubated at 37 °C for one hour. The plate's contents were discarded, then it was blotted and allowed to air dry. Subsequently, 50 µl of diluted faecal sample (final dilution 1:4 in EIA buffer) and 50 µl of 5α-androst-16-en-3-one standards followed by 50 µl of diluted 5α-androst-16-en-3-one antibody was added and incubated at 37 °C for 90 min. The plate was again washed with wash buffer, blotted, and 100 µl of horseradish peroxidase (HRP) conjugated goat anti-rabbit IgG secondary antibody was added in each well and incubated at 37 °C for 90 min. The plate was washed as mentioned above, and 100 µl of substrate solution TMB/H2O2 (Tetramethylbenzidine/Hydrogen peroxide, Genei) was added and incubated in dark for 5–10 mins (for colour development). The reaction was stopped with 50 µl of stopping solution (1 N HCL), and the ELISA reader (Thermo Multiskan Spectrum Plate Reader, version 2.4.2, Thermo Scientific, Finland) read the absorbence at 450 nm.

steps.title: Extract androstenone from faeces
steps.instruction: Weigh 0.5 g of wet faeces, add 3 mL of 80 % methanol, vortex for 30 min at room temperature, then store the mixture overnight at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the next day at 3300 g for 20 min.
Transfer the supernatant to a new tube and store at –20 °C until analysis.

steps.title: Prepare ELISA reagents
steps.instruction: Dilute the polyclonal anti‑androstenone antibody 1:25 600; prepare androstenone standards ranging from 1000 ng/mL to 3.9 ng/mL; use BSA‑conjugated 16,(5α)-androsten-3-one‑carboxymethyloxime at 1 mg/mL; dilute HRP‑conjugated goat anti‑rabbit IgG secondary antibody 1:10 000 (GeNei).

steps.title: Coat microtiter plate with antigen conjugate
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL per well of 1 µg/mL conjugate (16,(5α)-androsten-3-one‑carboxymethyloxime‑BSA) prepared in 0.05 M sodium bicarbonate buffer, pH 9.6; cover with cling wrap, place in a moist chamber and incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash and block plate
steps.instruction: Using an Elx50 (BioTek) automated washer, wash the plate four times with wash buffer (0.15 M NaCl, 0.05 % Tween 20). Then add 200 µL blocking buffer to each well and incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour. Discard the buffer, blot the plate and allow it to air‑dry.

steps.title: Add samples, standards, and primary antibody
steps.instruction: To each well add 50 µL of diluted faecal sample (final 1:4 dilution in EIA buffer) and 50 µL of the appropriate androstenone standard, followed by 50 µL of the diluted anti‑androstenone antibody; incubate at 37 °C for 90 min.

steps.title: Add HRP secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the plate as before, then add 100 µL of the HRP‑conjugated goat anti‑rabbit IgG secondary antibody to each well and incubate at 37 °C for 90 min.

steps.title: Develop color with TMB substrate
steps.instruction: Wash the plate again, add 100 µL of TMB/H₂O₂ substrate solution (Genei) to each well, and incubate in the dark for 5–10 min for colour development.

steps.title: Stop reaction and read absorbance
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of 1 N HCl to each well to stop the reaction, then measure absorbance at 450 nm using a Thermo Multiskan Spectrum Plate Reader (version 2.4.2).

steps.title: Calculate concentrations and perform statistics
steps.instruction: Determine urinary androstenone concentrations from the standard curve and express as ng/µg creatinine; express faecal androstenone as ng/g wet faeces (mean ± SEM). Compare groups using the Mann–Whitney U test.
